infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SpeakEasy needs the microphone to hear you practice speaking English.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SpeakEasy uses speech recognition to turn what you say into text so it can check your grammar.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow SpeakEasy to use the microphone.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow SpeakEasy to use speech recognition to transcribe what you say.
